messages:
liz_csm: Heads-up — EcoServe is showing a sharp usage drop and we have a renewal in ~40 days. They started a small pilot with FastServe AI last week and stakeholders have shifted to a new PM. Need triage.
omar_csm: Ugh. What metrics are we seeing? seats/requests/embedding ops? :eyes:
marta_success_ops: I pulled the last 60 days: active seats went 320 -> 58, monthly tokens for core generator fell 78% (see quick snippet).
raj_engineer: can you paste the query? I want to check error rates and latency changes. If our latency spiked they might've moved.
ekaterina_support: No incident reports from EcoServe in the window; last ticket was about auth but closed 2 weeks ago.
liz_csm: snippet: ```30d_active_seats: 320 -> 58
30d_gen_tokens: 12.4M -> 2.6M
avg_p95_latency: 210ms -> 215ms``` Not massive latency change. Seems product usage intentionally reduced.
sean_ae: I'm on this. I had an exec intro scheduled but they asked to push until after their internal review. They mentioned FastServe pricing and a feature gap around prompt templating.
omar_csm: Sounds like competitive eval + stakeholder change. Priority: 1) immediate outreach to new PM, 2) capture their evaluation criteria, 3) short-term win to keep them engaged.
marta_success_ops: I can run a targeted enablement playbook: quick templating workshop + 2-hour office hours for their engs. Recommend offering a pilot extension (30 days) with usage credits.
sean_ae: Agree on credits. I'll propose a 30-day extension and a dedicated enablement session. Need decision from finance on credits. @billing-bot can you surface what credit range we've offered historically for similar churn risk?
billing-bot: Past pilot extension credits for mid-market (ARR 150k-500k): $5k-$15k equivalent usage credits.
raj_engineer: From product side, we can ship a templating snippet and a small demo repo in 72 hours that maps to their use-case. Also can add a short-term workaround for the missing template macros.
ekaterina_support: I'll prepare the known issues + recommended settings doc and be on the enablement call.
liz_csm: Action list: 1) Sean to send exec note offering 30-day extension + credits (by EOD). 2) Marta to schedule templating workshop next week. 3) Raj to prepare demo repo (72h). 4) Ekaterina to compile support doc. 5) Omar to own stakeholder intro.
sean_ae: I'll draft the note now and ping for review. Quick ask: does anyone have a one-pager on cost delta vs FastServe for embeddings+chat? They claim 20% cheaper.
omar_csm: I have a quick cost delta slide — will post after lunch.
marta_success_ops: Also capture feedback: they said prompt templating UX is confusing and analytics per-route is limited. Add to product feedback list.
liz_csm: Good — make the feedback explicit in the next call so we can log it as a regression risk. If they surface security/KMS needs we escalate to Private early.
sean_ae: Draft sent to the thread (DMing first). Will copy in the new PM once approved.
ekaterina_support: Added: I'll make sure to capture their enablement sentiment and vote on renewal during the workshop.
liz_csm: OK team — treat as high risk but salvageable. Keep updates here. Next sync in 48h or sooner if we get PM reply. :thumbsup:
